text:
Incident-Bot: ALERT triggered: high 5xx rate on /v1/generate from eu-west-1 for the last 3m. severity=P2. link: https://alerts.redwood.example/INC-9876

Maya R: I’m on it — currently primary for tonight. Noted spike. Checking traffic and rolling error windows.

Sam K: I’m secondary, available on pager. If this looks like infra, I can take the bridge.

Maya R: Quick check: running the metrics curl to head off false positives

Maya R: ```bash
# check 5xx rate, 3m window
curl -s 'https://metrics.redwood/api/v1/query?query=rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5..",route="/v1/generate"}[3m])' | jq .
```

Leo N: FYI there was a deploy 20m ago (eng-runtime). No rollback yet. I can look at deploy job logs.

Maya R: Results: 5xx rate ~0.7% over last 3m (baseline ~0.05%). Erroring backend seems `inference-gateway` returning 502.

Sam K: Opening bridge: https://zoom.bridges/redwood/INC-9876. Will page infra lead if we can’t clear in 10m.

Incident-Bot: BRIDGE CREATED by Sam K — https://zoom.bridges/redwood/INC-9876. Pager notified: Sam K (secondary).

Maya R: Quick customer-impact assessment: 35 requests/min failing, mostly tails. No billing alerts yet. CS pinged. Marking potential customer impact = yes.

Tanvi S: IC at CS — which customers are affected? I’ll start outreach if it’s > 3 paid tenants.

Maya R: See `top_clients` query — looks like two medium customers (acct-42, acct-77) and some internal test traffic. Not widespread.

Alex P: If we need escalation: page infra oncall (pager: infra-oncall), then eng-runtime lead (@Leo N) after 10m if unresolved. For P1 escalate to on-call exec (pager: eng-leads).

Maya R: Triage plan: 1) verify if route is overloaded or gateway misrouting, 2) try intelligence fallback (route to model-variant B), 3) if fails, roll traffic to standby gateway.

Sam K: Quick commands I ran:```bash
# tail gateway logs for 502 patterns
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-gateway -c gateway --since=10m | grep -E "502|timeout|upstream" | tail -n 200
```

Maya R: Logs show repeated `upstream closed connection` to `model-worker-7`. Could be a worker OOM/failure.

Leo N: I’m on worker fleet. Checking ML node health and recent autoscaler events. If worker OOM, we can drain and restart nodes.

Sam K: Pager rule reminder (from runbook): - P2 (service degraded but functional): page secondary and infra after 10m. - P1 (customers impacted broadly or revenue-affecting): immediate page to eng-leads and execs. Link: https://runbooks.redwood.example/triage/oncall-pager-policy

Maya R: Coverage note — I’ll stay primary until handoff at 03:00 UTC. If this is still live at 02:50 UTC, we do a warm handoff: primary gives summary, outstanding actions, and known workarounds.

Tanvi S: If you foresee a long mitigation, please declare a P1 and kick off the incident postmortem template so SRE/CS can track comms.

Maya R: Agreed. Current ETA for mitigation: 15–25m (restart + validation). If restart doesn’t reduce errors within 5m, escalate to infra-oncall.

Incident-Bot: NOTE: escalation rule check passed. Next automatic reminder in 8m.

Sam K: I’m going to try restarting the affected workers in the canary pool; looping Leo.

Leo N: Restart started (rolling 3 nodes). Will report back when healthy.

Maya R: If restart succeeds, we’ll keep oncall notes: what changed, rollback steps, and whether autoscaler patches are needed. Also add a brief runbook pointer to the incident: https://runbooks.redwood.example/ops/inference-gateway-failures

Sam K: Update (02:05 UTC): error rate down to 0.08% after first restart wave. Customer impact minimal now.

Maya R: Nice. I’ll keep monitoring for 20m and then start a warm handoff if stable.

Tanvi S: CS notified customers (acct-42 & acct-77) with the mitigations and ETA.

Leo N: Will follow up with a short RCA note in the incident postmortem doc.

Maya R: Closing notes for handoff: primary=Maya R until 03:00 UTC (or earlier if stable), secondary=Sam K. Next escalation: infra-oncall (pager) -> eng-runtime lead (Leo N) -> eng-leads if P1. Runbook links above.

Sam K: :thumbsup: good job team.

Incident-Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: resolved=false; monitoring=true; reminders scheduled.
